title: Loop Lock
statementMarkdown:
Two drive gears mesh with **24** and **60** teeth respectively. The loop seal engages the first time both gears return to their starting orientation simultaneously.

**After how many tooth-steps does the seal engage?**
hints: You need the smallest count divisible by both 24 and 60.
Prime-factorize both gears: $2^3 \cdot 3$ and $2^2 \cdot 3 \cdot 5$. Take the maximum power of each.
